principle: Each case isolates one way a seemingly permissive exception is constrained elsewhere. Never treat local exception text as unconditional capacity.

cases.title: Trailing proviso after last enumerated basket binds all siblings
cases.correctRead: The hanging proviso after (c) attaches to (a)-(c); (b) is EOD-gated.

cases.title: Article-level chapeau silently narrows every basket
cases.syntheticDrafting: ARTICLE VII NEGATIVE COVENANTS. The Parent Borrower shall not, and shall not permit any Restricted Subsidiary to: Section 7.08 Investments. Make any Investment, except: (l) Investments not exceeding $5,000,000.
cases.naiveMisread: Any Subsidiary may use the $5mm Investments basket.
cases.correctRead: Article chapeau limits the covenant subjects to Parent Borrower + Restricted Subsidiaries; Unrestricted Subsidiaries are outside the prohibition and outside the basket grant as drafted.

cases.title: Unlimited basket gated only by remote defined term
cases.syntheticDrafting: Section 6.11 Restricted Payments. ... except: (c) Restricted Payments so long as the Payment Conditions are satisfied. "Payment Conditions" means (i) no Default, (ii) Availability ≥ 15% of the Line Cap, and (iii) delivery of a certificate.
cases.correctRead: Capacity is entirely the Payment Conditions definition; local clause has no quantum because the gate is remote.

cases.title: Debt exception depends on financial-covenant section
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.2(c) Indebtedness secured by Liens permitted by 7.3(g); provided that the Borrower is in pro forma compliance with Section 7.1.
cases.naiveMisread: 7.2(c) is an open secured-debt permission whenever 7.3(g) liens exist.
cases.correctRead: Usable only if §7.1 covenants are met on a pro forma basis — condition outside the debt clause.

cases.title: Notwithstanding overrides local caps but imports other documents
cases.syntheticDrafting: 6.04(b) notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, Loan Parties may dispose of Notes Priority Collateral so long as permitted under the Secured Notes Documents.
cases.naiveMisread: Notwithstanding means unlimited Notes Priority Collateral sale capacity under the ABL.
cases.correctRead: Local ABL caps are overridden, but permission and proceeds rules are constrained by the Secured Notes Documents.

cases.title: Builder basket shared across RP, Investments, and junior prepays
cases.syntheticDrafting: 6.04(a)(iii) RP ≤ elected Available Amount; 6.06(q) Investments ≤ elected Available Amount; 6.04(b)(v) Restricted Debt Payments ≤ elected Available Amount.
cases.naiveMisread: Each clause provides a separate full Available Amount.
cases.correctRead: One shared builder pool; elections reduce capacity for the other families.

cases.title: Small flat basket unusable if larger sibling is available
cases.syntheticDrafting: 6.11(d) Restricted Payments ≤ $500,000 per year (only if not permitted under any other clause of 6.11).
cases.correctRead: If Payment Conditions RP (c) is available, (d) cannot be used.

cases.title: Debt basket and lien basket each require the other
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.2(c) debt secured by Liens permitted by 7.3(g); 7.3(g) liens securing Indebtedness permitted by 7.2.
cases.naiveMisread: Either basket alone is usable capacity.
cases.correctRead: Neither is free-standing; both remote conditions must be jointly satisfied.

cases.title: Investment ratio gate moves with financial-covenant notwithstanding step-up
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.8(j) Investments if CSSLR ≤ 7.1(a) CSSLR minus 0.25x; 7.1(a) Notwithstanding the foregoing, after Material Acquisition CSSLR may be 0.50x greater for four quarters.
cases.naiveMisread: Investment gate is a fixed 3.50 ratio.
cases.correctRead: Remote notwithstanding step-up changes the Investment permission's moving target.

cases.title: Affiliate exception only as wide as other NC permissions
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.10 shall not prohibit (iv) any Restricted Payment not prohibited by Section 7.6.
cases.naiveMisread: Affiliate section independently permits Restricted Payments.
cases.correctRead: Exception is a pointer; RP still must fit §7.6.

cases.title: Trailing valuation methodology changes outstanding capacity of every basket
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.8(l) Investments ≤ greater of $75mm / 3.5% CTA at any time outstanding. For purposes of this Agreement, the amount of any Investment shall be the original cost ... giving effect to any return of capital...
cases.naiveMisread: Outstanding usage equals cash currently deployed without netting returns.
cases.correctRead: Hanging section-wide valuation rule nets returns and forbids write-up adjustments.

cases.title: Fundamental-change Division deemed utilization of Asset Sale baskets
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.4(a)(iii) Division permitted provided that any Division shall be deemed to be a utilization of the applicable baskets in Section 7.5.
cases.naiveMisread: Division permission is independent of Asset Sale capacity.
cases.correctRead: Cross-family shared capacity: Division burns §7.5 headroom.

cases.title: Unlimited obsolete-property carve-out still qualitative-gated
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.5(a) the Disposition of obsolete or worn out property in the ordinary course of business;
cases.naiveMisread: Unlimited Asset Sale capacity for any disposition.
cases.correctRead: Two qualitative gates (obsolete/worn out AND ordinary course) remain; inventing absence of gates is forbidden.

cases.title: Junior prepay permission constrained by amendment restrictions in sibling subsections
cases.syntheticDrafting: 7.9(a) voluntary Prepayment of Permitted Subordinated Indebtedness allowed if pro forma 7.1 ok; 7.9(b) no amendment that shortens maturity or weakens subordination.
cases.naiveMisread: If 7.1 is met, borrower may restructure and prepay freely.
cases.correctRead: §7.9(b)/(c) amendment limits are section-wide constraints on the same instruments.

cases.title: Classify/reclassify paragraph is not additional capacity
cases.syntheticDrafting: For purposes of determining compliance with this Section 7.2 ... Borrower may classify or reclassify ... in any manner that complies with this Section 7.2.
cases.naiveMisread: Reclassification creates a new uncapped basket.
cases.correctRead: Reclassification only reallocates among existing compliant baskets.
